snippet.title: Hoverise Rebellion Dev Teaser [Work in progress] - Zeak Games
snippet.description:
🚀 Get ready for the rebellion.

🎮 Hoverise Rebellion is a futuristic third-person shooter where you pilot powerful HoverTanks in explosive battles against a rogue AI. Choose your playstyle, master unique movement mechanics, and fight for control of a world on the brink. 👾

🕹 Add it to your Steam wishlist and join the resistance:
🔗 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902060/Hoverise_Rebellion/

🛠 Currently in development: stay tuned for updates and gameplay reveals!

💥 Follow us for more:
Instagram: https://instagram.com/zeak_games/
TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@zeak_games
Twitter/X: https://x.com/ZeakGames

#GameTrailer #IndieDev #UnrealEngine5 #IndieGame
